description: This file contains Java classes defining Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) related to authentication, including registration requests, login requests, and authentication responses, with schema annotations for API documentation and validation constraints.

classes.name: AuthDtos
classes.description: Container class for authentication-related DTOs, including nested classes for request and response payloads.

classes.name: AuthDtos.RegisterRequest
classes.description: DTO for user registration request, including username, email, and password with validation annotations.

classes.name: AuthDtos.LoginRequest
classes.description: DTO for user login request, including username and password with validation annotations.

classes.name: AuthDtos.AuthResponse
classes.description: DTO for authentication response containing JWT token, username, with a constructor for instantiation.

methods.name: AuthDtos.AuthResponse
methods.description: Constructor to initialize token and username fields.
